title: Levi HaSard or HaSadr, a Tanna
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Mekhilta at the beginning of Parashat Ki Tisa and in Yoma 85a: that Rabbi Yishmael, Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah were walking along the road, while Levi HaSered and Rabbi Yishmael, son of Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah, were walking behind them. And the Arukh explains that he made 'bigdei serad' (woven/service garments).

notes.text: The Arukh’s explanation connects the epithet with making bigdei serad, service garments. Both HaSard and HaSadr remain the supplied name forms.
